scope: Bounded rapid review of FASTQ data integrity, explicit quality encoding, and practical reporting; no organism-specific biology, trimming implementation, or clinical use.

inclusion_criteria: Primary software/methods publications directly relevant to the operational gap
Official data-provider/software documentation for precise contracts
Recent publication window 2022-01-01 to 2026-10-20, with clearly labeled foundational lookup
exclusion_criteria: Disease or organism applications without a direct reliability-method contribution
Broader pipelines or single-cell workflows outside scope
Preprints excluded from adopted evidence in this round
